title: Final Project Rubric
description: The final thesis is graded against the standard Written Thesis Rubric, plus the additional criteria below specific to a capstone-length, course-spanning work.

levels.descriptor: Draws on one module only. Could have been written before the course.
Draws on two or three modules but treats them as separate domains.
Draws on at least four modules and shows the connections between them.
Draws on at least four modules and produces an insight none of those modules contained on its own.
Thesis is unfalsifiable. No specific observation could refute it.
Thesis is technically falsifiable but the conditions are vague.
Thesis comes with three specific, observable, dated mind-change conditions.
Three specific conditions AND the writer signals which one they think is most likely to occur.
